def CatalogueBound : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℕ, r < catalogueModulus → Nat.Coprime r catalogueModulus →
    22 ≤ ({p ∈ Finset.Ioo 324 (2 ^ catalogueModulus ^ 3) |
      p.Prime ∧ p % catalogueModulus = r}).card

evidence: CatalogueBound (the 2^(W^3) form) is only a def, used as a hypothesis of catalogueBound8_of_catalogueBound and cataloguePrime_lt_of_catalogueBound. Every proved catalogue estimate uses the 2^(W^8) cutoff: Hmax < 2^W^8, Hcat <= (2^W^8)^(22W), Ns < 2^2^4613. The small bounds W > 10^5, W < 2^435 and 2^2000 < F0 < 2^2250 match [M] or are sharper, so the claim holds.

catalogue_bounds and catalogue_size state Hmax < 2^(W^8), Hcat <= (2^(W^8))^(22W), Ns < 2^2^4613, all from CatalogueBound8; the 2^(W^3) CatalogueBound is a definition only used as a premise of catalogueBound8_of_catalogueBound and is never proved, so [M]'s X = 2^(W^3) estimates and log2 Ns < 2^2054 have no proved counterpart. small_constant_bounds gives W > 10^5, W < 2^435 and 2^2000 < F < 2^2250 as claimed.
